messages:
ana (product): Quick heads-up: SDK v4 rollout begins now. Main changes: unified Quickstart, rename `sync_mode` -> `mode`, and streaming now defaults to chunked HTTP. See migration link: https://go.redwood/sdks/v4-migration

mike (eng-runtime): Will there be a compatibility shim for `sync_mode`?

ana (product): yes — 90-day deprecation window with runtime warnings. Example to update: `client = RedwoodClient(mode="blocking")` (old: `sync_mode=True`).

jess (devex): I'll patch Quickstart, examples, and the runnable snippets. Adding CI checklist: test both modes during deprecation.

nina (docs): Drafting migration appendix and a small troubleshooting section. Plan to publish draft by EOD tomorrow.

ben (support): Preparing KB + canned replies for customers who see the deprecation warning. Recommend in-console banner two weeks before removal.

legal-bot: Reminder: any external comms mentioning SLAs need Legal approval. Tagging @legal.

ci-bot: Canary tests: 276/276 passed on v4 canary; tokenization and streaming tests OK.

mike (eng-runtime): Logging will emit `DEPRECATION: sync_mode removed on 2026-06-30` — please don't suppress warnings in prod.

ana (product): Action items: devex/docs to update examples, support to prep comms, legal to review external wording. I'll post an exec summary in #product tomorrow. :rocket:
file_note: internal announcement thread: SDK v4 launch, docs/migration, deprecation plan
